selection_timing: Frozen after structural sampling and before any accepted W/D/L solve for G7F07/G7F08.

model.white_bishop: wrong-colour relative to a8 (colour complex C=0 under C=(file+rank) mod 2)
model.pawn_window: brink-only: pawns are fixed on rank 7/2 and have only legal promotion moves; captures by kings/bishops remove them into an internal optional-material closure
model.terminal_semantics: ordinary mate/stalemate; either-side legal promotion is immediate win for promoting side; no repetition/en-passant/move-count state
model.static_validity: distinct pieces, nonadjacent kings, bishop colour restrictions, side-not-to-move not already in check; same convention as certified G7F01/F02
model.purpose: higher-tree multi-resource transition stress, matched bishop-colour exchange contrast, and an adversarial resource-safe TARGET test with three simultaneous one-move promotion resources

families.name: BB_opp_a7c7_b2
families.topology: opposite-colour bishops; bishop-bishop direct exchange suppressed; three brink promotion resources

families.name: BB_same_a7c7_b2
families.topology: same-colour bishops; direct exchanges enabled; three brink promotion resources

selection_reasoning: a7 retains direct wrong-colour rook-pawn/corner ancestry without selecting on outcome truth.
c7 adds a second independent White conversion resource and multiple lower-material capture endpoints.
b2 gives Black an equally advanced opposing promotion resource, making race/resource guards nontrivial rather than automatically satisfied.
F07/F08 are a matched pair: pawn geometry and White bishop complex are fixed; only Black bishop colour changes.
The pair is materially seven-man and structurally distinct from merely shifting a G6 pawn file.
predeclared_transfer_tests: Exact full-material W/D/L and lower-material signature DAG.
Direct capture endpoint diversity and exchange density.
Unchanged G6 TARGET_RACE_CLEAR/TARGET_RACE_PATH_CLEAR type/domain audit before any repaired target is proposed.
G6 strict attractor / branch-hyperkernel operations over exact lower-material endpoints where targets are sound.
Sanctuary compatibility audit: do not transfer the G6 faithful-fortress BK=a8 theorem across the brink promotion-terminal model without explicit re-certification.
